Existing photo-prep tool supplied for this Director route.

One flag was added to that script: --already-cut skips a second rembg so the existing ONNX upscaler can run on a tight alpha crop. No new upscaler and no weights are included.
The box ONNX file stays where it is. Point PREP_ONNX_MODEL at it when this copy of the script is the command.
